claim: Anthropic is collapsing chat, delegated work, design, documents and presentations into one task-routed workspace, commoditizing basic artifact production.
verifiedFacts: Anthropic announced a unified Claude interface combining chat and Cowork and integrating Design.
Claude Docs and Slides entered beta with export to common office formats.
inference: Consultancy differentiation should move toward provenance, editability, review receipts and portability rather than raw deck generation.
significance: High for Observation and Melodyfire because artifact generation itself is becoming less defensible.
assumptions: Integrated artifact creation will reduce willingness to pay for undifferentiated production.
knownLimitations: Beta quality and adoption metrics are unavailable.
